text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications, and I’d love to help you develop your e-commerce website from scratch.

Your project calls for a Laravel and VueJS expert, and while my core background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS, I bring extensive experience delivering clean, scalable user interfaces and reliable backend integrations for production products. I’m comfortable working across the stack, translating business requirements into smooth, maintainable user experiences.

One project I’d highlight is a streaming chat widget for Quillstack in the edtech space. I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token using React, TypeScript, Server-Sent Events, Node.js, and the OpenAI API. A key result was getting the first token on screen in about 600 ms, which helped support 30k chats a month. That experience strengthened my ability to build responsive interfaces, handle real-time interactions, and create dependable systems that feel fast and polished to users.

For an e-commerce build, I’d approach the work with a strong focus on structure, usability, and long-term maintainability. I’m experienced with full stack implementation, API-driven features, and building interfaces that support clear navigation, smooth user flows, and clean product presentation. I also understand the importance of reliable payments, responsive design, and a solid foundation for future growth.

I’m detail-oriented, communicative, and comfortable taking ownership of a project from the ground up. If you’re looking for someone who can contribute broad technical experience and a practical, product-focused mindset, I’d be glad to discuss how I can help bring this e-commerce website to life.
